metaDescription: Found a weakness in {siteName}? Tell us. How to report it, what happens next, and our promise to people who research in good faith.
title: Report a security problem
lead: Found a weakness in {siteName}? Please tell us first. We read every report, we reply, and we fix what is real.

onlyDomain.title: Our only website
onlyDomain.body: The only website of {siteName} is <site>{domain}</site>. Our emails link only to it.

never.link: We never ask you to pay by link or bank transfer.
never.card: We never ask for your card details.
never.code: We never ask for a login code — not by email, SMS or WhatsApp.

onlyDomain.fake: Seen a copy of {siteName} at another address, or got a message like that? <report>Report it to us</report>.

report.title: What to report
report.lead: A problem in the site itself that could hurt the people who use it, for example:

items.data: A way to see or change someone else's details: bookings, trips, exact addresses, phone numbers or messages.
items.accounts: A way into someone else's account, or into the admin panel.
items.limits: A way around a protection: login codes, two-step login, the booking limit or the "show contact" limit.
items.code: Code that runs on our pages (XSS), or a way to make our server fetch other addresses (SSRF).
items.secrets: A key, password or file of ours that anyone can reach.

not.scams: A suspicious listing, host or guest: use "Report" on the listing, or see the <safety>Safety Center</safety>.
not.account: Trouble with your own account or a booking: <help>Help & support</help>.
not.scanners: Results of an automated scanner, or a missing setting, without a real way to cause harm.

how.title: How to report
how.noEmail: Open a <ticket>support request</ticket> with the topic "Technical problem" and write "Security" in the subject. We will reply with a private address to continue.

items.what: What you found, and where (the page or the address).
items.steps: The steps that show it again.
items.impact: What someone could do with it.

how.languages: Hebrew or English is best. We read the other languages of the site too.
how.privacy: Please don't send other people's personal details. A screenshot from your own test account is enough.

items.confirm: We confirm that your report arrived, and we reply to you.
items.check: We check it and tell you whether we can see the problem too.
items.fix: We fix real problems as fast as we can and tell you when it's done.
items.reward: We don't pay rewards at the moment, but we are grateful for every report.

safeHarbour.title: Our promise to good-faith researchers
safeHarbour.body: If you look for problems in good faith and follow the rules on this page, we will not take legal action against you or file a complaint about it, and we treat your research as allowed.
safeHarbour.note: Draft: our lawyer reviews this promise before launch.

items.data: Open, copy, change or delete other people's data. Use only your own accounts, and stop and tell us as soon as you see someone else's details.
items.disrupt: Slow the site down or flood it: no denial-of-service tests, no mass automated scans, no spam.
items.people: Trick our team, hosts or guests (fake emails, phone calls), or try anything physical.
items.real: Make real bookings, contact hosts, or send login codes to numbers that are not yours.
items.public: Tell others before we have fixed it. Give us 90 days, or agree on a date with us.

machine: For tools: our <file>security.txt</file> file has the same contact.
